tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search the store catalog. Returns title, price (UZS), delivery fee, availability, url and image. Product names are in Uzbek or Russian; short keywords in either language match best, with the specific product type kept ("smart soat" returns smartwatches, "soat" returns every kind of watch).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
Full product details: description, all images, video, variants (size/color with their own price and availability), delivery terms and the total to pay.
Example: {"product_id": 1234} — the id comes from a search_products result.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: The store's official policies: delivery area (Uzbekistan only), delivery time and fee, payment (cash to the courier on delivery; no cards or online payments), how orders are confirmed by phone, inspection on delivery, returns and the support contact. tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places a real cash-on-delivery order for the shopper. A call-center operator phones the given number to confirm, then a courier delivers and collects payment. tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description:
Status of an order placed earlier. Requires the order id and the last 4 digits of the customer's phone.
Example: {"order_id": 100500, "phone_last4": "4567"}.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
